settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.content: Answers to the questions we hear most about pricing, delivery, ATS, revisions, refunds, and the writing process. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact us.

settings.question: How much do Hire Nestt's services cost?
settings.answer: Pricing ranges from $55 to $399 depending on the package and scope of work, listed in USD on every product page with no hidden checkout fees.

settings.question: Which package should I choose?
settings.answer: Match your career stage: graduates typically start with the Entry-Level Graduate Package, working professionals choose Professional Resume or Resume + Cover Letter, and senior leaders choose the Job Hunter Bundle, Executive Career Package, or Ultimate Career Transformation.

settings.question: Can I combine or upgrade a package after purchase?
settings.answer: Yes — reply to your order confirmation email or contact hirenest56@gmail.com and we'll advise on the price difference and next steps.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery ranges from 2 business days (Starter Career Package) up to 5-7 business days (Ultimate Career Transformation), starting once we receive your background details.

settings.question: How will I receive my finished documents?
settings.answer: All completed documents are delivered by email as attachments — there is no physical shipment or tracking number involved.

settings.question: What if I don't hear back by my delivery date?
settings.answer: Contact hirenest56@gmail.com with your order number and we'll locate your order and provide an update.

settings.question: What is ATS, and why does it matter?
settings.answer: ATS stands for Applicant Tracking System — software many employers use to sort and search resumes before a human reviews them. Formatting and keyword alignment are built into every package.

settings.question: Do you guarantee my resume will pass every ATS?
settings.answer: No single writer can guarantee results with every employer's specific software. We follow widely used ATS-safe formatting and keyword conventions.

settings.question: How do you choose which keywords to include?
settings.answer: Keywords are drawn from your target job titles, industry, and existing resume — never inserted generically just to game a system.

settings.question: How many revisions come with each package?
settings.answer: From 1 revision on entry-level packages up to unlimited revisions for 30 days on the Executive and Ultimate packages. See each package page for exact counts.

settings.question: What counts as a revision?
settings.answer: Edits to the delivered draft — wording, section order, adding a role — rather than a full rewrite for a different job target, which is treated as a new project.

settings.question: What is Hire Nestt's refund policy?
settings.answer: A refund is available if you cancel before drafting has started. Once drafting begins, revisions are the mechanism for addressing feedback rather than a refund. See our full Refund Policy.

settings.question: Can I cancel my order before work starts?
settings.answer: Yes — contact hirenest56@gmail.com before drafting begins and you're eligible for a refund.

settings.question: Do you need access to my LinkedIn account?
settings.answer: No. Optimized content is delivered as a document for you to paste into your own profile — we never request your login.

settings.question: Can I bundle LinkedIn with my resume and cover letter?
settings.answer: Yes — the Job Hunter Bundle combines resume, cover letter, and LinkedIn optimization at a lower combined price than purchasing separately.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Payments are processed securely through Shopify checkout, typically including major cards plus any additional methods enabled, such as PayPal or Shop Pay.

settings.question: Is it safe to enter my card details?
settings.answer: Yes — checkout is handled by Shopify's PCI-compliant system. Hire Nestt never directly receives or stores your card details.

settings.question: Is my resume and personal information kept confidential?
settings.answer: Yes. Your details are kept private and are never shared with or sold to third parties.

settings.question: Do you use my information to train AI models or share it with other companies?
settings.answer: No. Your information is used solely to deliver the service you purchased.

settings.question: What file formats will I receive?
settings.answer: An editable Word document (.docx) and a PDF version for every resume and cover letter package, plus a LinkedIn copy document where applicable.

settings.question: Will my resume work if I'm applying outside my home country?
settings.answer: Yes — we serve clients worldwide in professional English. Let us know your target country so formatting conventions can be tailored accordingly.

settings.question: Do you guarantee I'll get interviews or a job offer?
settings.answer: No. We provide professionally written, well-formatted career documents, but outcomes depend on factors outside any writer's control.

settings.question: I'm changing careers with no direct experience in my target industry — can you help?
settings.answer: Yes — we focus on transferable skills and reframe past experience around your target role.

settings.question: Can students or first-time job seekers use your services?
settings.answer: Yes — the Entry-Level Graduate Package is built specifically for students and recent graduates.
